construction: Authored guide-based reconstruction with physical deck boards, timber structure, opened access and visible historical interiors. Source game statistics determine class and gun counts; dimensions/offsets are estimates, not extracted stock meshes.

provenance.method: Original procedural construction from authored offsets following repository guide chapters 02–09 and 12–13. No binary game meshes or proprietary textures imported.
provenance.dimension_status: Authored reconstruction: dimensions are design choices, not measured stock POTC2003 model dimensions.

claims: Ordinary game family, class and cannon count only.
Qualitative deck/mast layout only; no official metre dimensions.
Contemporary ordinary ship roster and gun counts.
Stock family role and distinction from mod variants.
Type-name uncertainty and small single-mast Tartane cue; historical dictionary is insufficient to establish game model.

provenance.limitations: Stock-derived walk script has widely separated fore/main climbing groups and high aft deck. Contemporary player discussion describes an armed fast trader and distinguishes the later gaff-boom Galeoth. The mixed square/lateen set rig is our inference, not a claim to recover the proprietary stock mesh.

source.distinctive_silhouette: Broad round afterbody, pronounced quarterdeck, widely separated fore/main masts with square canvas and an aft lateen.

static_scope.collision: Shared exact static concave hull/deck solids; no playable deck claim.

source.authored_deck_clearance: Quarterdeck break at-.285L lies between the first two gun carriage footprints. Main shrouds lead forward from their mast so their real iron fastenings clear the transverse bulkhead and the authored canvas. Forecastle starts ahead of the battery.
